pages.title: Hot Pot Chef
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Hot Pot Chef turns a hotpot full of ingredients into a sorting puzzle. Tap items to move them into a tray, collecting three identical ingredients to complete a match and fill food orders. Ingredients sit on different layers, so choose what you need for the current orders. Finish every order and clear the hotpot to complete the level.

pages.title: Marble Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Marble Sort is a color-sorting puzzle built around a conveyor belt. Tap a tray to release its marbles, then sort the moving pieces into holders of the matching color. Three identical marbles complete a holder. Manage the flow around the belt and finish all the trays to clear the level.

pages.title: Cube Drop Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Cube Drop Puzzle asks you to pair colorful bears with holes of the same color so they can jump into the lake. Work out which bear belongs in each opening and move through the puzzle's arrangements. Later levels leave less room to work with, making the color-matching task more complicated.

pages.title: Forest Glade Mysteries
pages.creator: H5 Games
pages.description: Forest Glade Mysteries is an animal-matching puzzle set in a magical forest. Make lines of at least three identical animals to complete each board's tasks before the available moves run out. Progress through the forest's levels and meet more animal characters as you solve the matching challenges.

pages.title: Powerwash Simulator - 3D Wash
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Powerwash Simulator - 3D Wash puts a pressure washer in your hands to clean dirty objects and surfaces. Point the spray at built-up dirt and work across areas such as patios and vehicles, restoring each surface as the grime washes away.

pages.title: Draw Brige Puzzle
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Draw Brige Puzzle challenges you to draw roads that get a stranded car to its destination. Create a path that lets the vehicle navigate past obstacles and cross the gaps in its route. Each puzzle is about finding a bridge layout that brings the car through safely.

pages.title: My DOGY Virtual Pet
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Care for a puppy in My DOGY Virtual Pet. Feed Dogy when he is hungry, bathe him, play games with him and put him to bed when he needs rest. The icons at the top show how his needs are progressing. Visit the different rooms and use mouse or touch input to keep those bars full.

pages.title: Noob fun fishing
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Noob fun fishing sends you after fish ranging from small catches to large predators. Build up the fish catalog, improve your fishing rod and its modifiers, and buy or upgrade a boat as you develop your equipment. Either mouse button casts or pulls the rod. F moves left and B moves right.

pages.title: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle asks you to fit colored screws into their matching nuts. Drag a screw to a nut of the same color, arranging the pieces without overlaps or blocking another screw's route. Match every screw to finish the puzzle. Challenge Mode links the puzzles to completing a picture.

pages.title: Number Domination
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Number Domination is a turn-based contest for control of a numbered board. Place cards valued from zero to nine to make pairs, chains of at least three, or a Perfect 9 formed by two cards adding up to nine. Successful moves score points and claim tiles.

Occupied tiles add an extra point for their owner at the end. Choose Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and use mouse or touchpad input to place your cards.

pages.title: Bubble Ball
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Bubble Ball is an untimed bubble shooter about clearing matching clusters and earning points. Use the arrow shooter to create groups of at least three bubbles of one color, popping them to gain points and special gifts. Aim with the mouse and left-click to shoot.

pages.title: BillyTheBox
pages.creator: CrudeProd
pages.description: BillyTheBox is a movement puzzle in which you guide a colored sphere to its required position. Click the light white suggestion cubes to move the player, choosing a route that brings the sphere into place. Try to solve the arrangement in as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Ocean Kids Back To School
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ocean Kids Back To School combines dressing up with a repair activity. Help the children choose outfits, hairstyles, accessories and school supplies for their first day of classes. After their school preparations, help fix their Vespa. Use the left mouse button to make selections and interact with the activities.

pages.title: Vex X3M
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Vex X3M puts a motorbike into thirty obstacle-filled racing levels. Reach the finish while getting past spikes, flying knives, rockets and lasers, and earn stars to unlock more bike skins. Both easy and hard modes are available.

Up or W accelerates, Left and Right or A and D tilt the bike, and Down or S brakes. Watch the course and its signs as you time the bike's movement through each hazard.

pages.title: Mr. Dude: King of the Hill
pages.creator: SeriousGames
pages.description:
Mr. Dude: King of the Hill puts a fugitive on a mountain surrounded by residents who want to hand him to the police. Knock out opponents, drag them and throw them, or use objects as weapons to defeat the enemies and take control of the hill.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, pick up items with F and climb with E. Use the left mouse button to attack or throw and the right button to aim.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2 challenges you to clear farm-themed layouts by matching pairs of free tiles. Work through chapters to unlock more puzzles, or choose Quick Play for a random arrangement.

Shuffle can help with difficult pairs, while Torch and Hint provide other assistance. Keep removing matching tiles until the board is empty and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Puzzle
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet Puzzle uses a stretching head to help its toilet character escape the Cameramen. Drag with the mouse or use the touchscreen to extend the head across the map and solve each level. Take too long and an alarm alerts the pursuers. Successful levels award coins that you can spend on new character skins.

pages.title: Lost Heroes
pages.creator: Y-rec
pages.description:
Lost Heroes is a fantasy puzzle platformer about a group trying to reach the necromancer who turned their village into an undead army. Use each hero's different abilities to solve obstacles and bring every character to the exit.

The arrow keys move, Space jumps and Tab changes the active hero. Left Control attacks, Shift runs and Z uses a special skill. Keyboard and gamepad play are supported.

pages.title: Burnout Drift
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Burnout Drift combines drifting with driving through traffic in daytime and nighttime settings. Steer through the roads, manage the traffic around you and modify the vehicle to suit your preferences. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space to brake.

pages.title: Link Line Puzzle
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description:
Link Line Puzzle asks you to connect every pair of same-colored dots while filling the whole grid. Draw a line from one dot to its partner, keeping the routes separate: crossing an existing line breaks it.

Boards range from 5 by 5 to 10 by 10 squares, with more colors adding complexity. Finish only when all pairs are connected, no lines cross and every square is covered. Hints are available if a route has you stuck.

pages.title: Snake Yo
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Snake Yo puts you in control of a snake that grows by eating magical food. Survive for as long as possible and destroy enemy snakes to build your score. Dash gives you another way to maneuver during difficult encounters.

On a computer, guide the snake with the mouse cursor and hold the left button to dash. Touchscreen buttons handle turning and dashing on mobile.

pages.title: Spill Wine
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Spill Wine is a physics puzzle about breaking every wine glass in a level. Throw colored balls and make use of objects such as large balls, sticks and cubes to bring the glasses down. Clear the glass-breaking challenge to move through the levels.

pages.title: Car Garage Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two garage pictures in Car Garage Differences and locate at least five changed details. Select them with the mouse or touchpad, using a hint when a difference is hard to find. Finishing with time or hints left earns extra points through time and hint bonuses.

pages.title: Paper Fold 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Paper Fold 3D turns a sheet of paper into a picture through a sequence of folds. Click or tap its corners in the correct order to complete the pattern. More backgrounds and patterns can be unlocked as you play, and hints can help when the folding order is unclear.

pages.title: Monster Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description:
Monster Shooter sends you into a fog-covered abandoned area to eliminate mutants and tree monsters, including the Lilac Head. Fight with weapons such as a pistol, shotgun, sniper rifle, ax and grenades as you clear the territory.

Use WASD to move and the mouse to look around. Left-click fires, holding the right button aims and R reloads. The mouse wheel or number keys change weapons, Space jumps and G throws a grenade.

pages.title: Rhino Rush Stampede
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Guide the little blue character in Rhino Rush Stampede on a hunt for more fruit. Press W or Up to jump, and S, Down, Right or Space to dash. The adventure also includes animals and vehicles, which use Up and Down controls.

pages.title: Ball Jumper
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Ball Jumper challenges you to break through the floors and guide a ball into the hole. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, clearing the layers that stand between the ball and its destination. The game contains ten levels.

pages.title: Gorillas Tiles Of The Unexpected
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Gorillas Tiles Of The Unexpected asks you to remove every tile across three levels. Select matching groups of at least two tiles with the mouse or a finger. When no matches remain, switch to bomb mode to create new matching opportunities and continue clearing the board.

pages.title: Cookie Crunch
pages.creator: WildLabox
pages.description: Cookie Crunch is a match-three puzzle featuring cookies and candy. Make matching groups of three to remove sweets from the board and work through the game's puzzle challenges.

pages.title: Stick Clash Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stick Clash Online starts you alone on a battlefield where defeated enemies can join your team. Build an army by choosing battles you can win, comparing your strength with each opposing group before attacking. Lead the growing team against the other mobs and defeat the monster at the bottom of the map.

pages.title: Hit Master 3D Knife Assassin
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Hit Master 3D Knife Assassin challenges you to take down hunters one at a time. Tap to shoot and keep working through the enemies until none remain.

pages.title: Christmas Rush
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Help Santa collect gift packs in Christmas Rush while avoiding obstacles along his route. Survive for as long as possible and pick up glittering stars to gain a magical power-up. Use the Up and Down arrows on a computer, or swipe up and down on a touchscreen, to move Santa.

pages.title: Slenderman Horror Story MadHouse
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Slenderman Horror Story MadHouse follows an escape attempt from an asylum after an encounter with Slenderman. Solve puzzles and fight hostile patients as you search for a way out, with the threat of Slenderman still hanging over the journey.

Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button and use the right button to raise your sights or block. R reloads, Shift sprints, Control crouches and Space jumps. G throws a grenade and T activates bullet time.

pages.title: Funny Bunnies Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Funny Bunnies Coloring offers eight pictures and a palette of 23 colors. Choose a bunny image and add colors with the mouse or touch controls, creating your own version of the drawing. You can save the finished picture when you are done.

pages.title: Sports Car Wash 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Sports Car Wash 2D is a car-cleaning game in which you wash vehicles. Tap to play and work on getting the cars clean.

pages.title: World Best Cooking Recipes
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: World Best Cooking Recipes brings together cooking activities inspired by food from Australia, Asia, Africa, North America and South America. Work through the recipes and prepare dishes from different parts of the world, using the mouse or tapping to play.

pages.title: Darkmaster and Lightmaiden
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Darkmaster and Lightmaiden is a cooperative puzzle game built around two partners. Help the characters work together to solve each level's puzzles and get past its obstacles. Use the arrow keys to move, Space to change the controlled character and E to perform an action.

pages.title: Emoticons
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Use mouse or touch controls to move the paddle and hit the emojis in Emoticons. Keep them from reaching the ground to continue scoring as the game speeds up.

pages.title: Endless Tunnel
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Endless Tunnel sends a cube through a 3D passage filled with obstacles. Slide left and right with mouse or touch controls to find a clear route. The tunnel keeps getting faster, reducing the time available to position the cube as you try to keep going.

pages.title: Car Charging Station
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Car Charging Station is a jigsaw game featuring pictures of charging cars. Choose an image, start the puzzle and drag the shuffled pieces into their correct positions to rebuild the scene.

pages.title: Real Coach Bus Simulator 3D 2019
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Real Coach Bus Simulator 3D 2019 is a bus-driving game focused on completing routes. Take the bus through its journeys and work toward finishing them all. The simulator includes school and articulated buses, detailed interiors and visible vehicle damage.

pages.title: Anna Life Cycle
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Anna Life Cycle is a dress-up game following Anna's changing appearance from childhood to adulthood and her grandmother years. Begin with her childhood look and style her through the different stages of her life. Use the mouse or touch input to make the selections.

pages.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Buffalo Chicken Dip is a cooking game that walks you through making a party dip inspired by Buffalo chicken wings. Follow the game's instructions to work through the recipe and prepare the appetizer.

pages.title: Xtreme Dirt Bike Racing Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Xtreme Dirt Bike Racing Game sends you over rugged terrain and bumpy tracks on a dirt bike. Handle the difficult routes and take on motorcycle stunts as you work through the racing challenge.

pages.title: King Rugni Tower Defense
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: King Rugni Tower Defense puts you against waves of elementals across different territories. Build towers to strengthen the defense and stop the enemies from getting through. Each level gives you ten lives, and at least one must remain to finish. Watch for the bosses at the end of each zone: letting one escape loses the level.

pages.title: Tower Destroyer
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Tower Destroyer challenges you to knock down towers built from geometric shapes. Fire balls at the structure while avoiding the obstacles in the way. Use the left mouse button or Space to shoot and keep working until the tower is destroyed.

pages.title: Bench Press The Barbarian
pages.creator: Athletic Design
pages.description: Bench Press The Barbarian is a physics-based lifting game with an unevenly matched pair of arms. The right arm is twice as strong as the left, making it difficult to keep the bar under control. Tap the left-hand buttons twice as quickly to compensate, or place weight plates on the right side to offset the imbalance.

pages.title: Derby Destruction Simulator Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Derby Destruction Simulator Game puts a car into a demolition arena. Drive into the action, smash other vehicles and try to survive the collisions on the field. The challenge centers on handling your car through the destructive encounters.

pages.title: DuckPark io
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description:
DuckPark io sends rubber ducks racing down a waterslide toward a bath. Steer past opponents, push them off the slide, collect gliders and look for chances to fly off the track. New duck skins provide more appearances to collect.

Use the Left and Right arrows or click and move the mouse to steer. Fast mouse movement from side to side lets the duck jump off the slide.

pages.title: Mountain Bike Rider
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Mountain Bike Rider gives you nine bike courses to complete. Use WASD to control the bike and work toward reaching the finish in each level. The game tracks a score as you ride through its challenges.

pages.title: HeadShot Bullet
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: HeadShot Bullet puts you in control of a single bullet after it is fired. Guide it through as many targets as possible, using its flight path to keep the shot going. Hold the left mouse button to move upward and release it to descend.

pages.title: Speed Billiard
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Speed Billiard challenges you to clear a table of fifteen balls as quickly as possible. The attempt ends once every ball is pocketed, and the number of seconds you used becomes your record. Play with mouse or touch controls and work toward a faster clearance.

pages.title: Xmas Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Xmas Bubble Shooter replaces bubbles with Christmas lights across 36 levels. Shoot to make groups of at least three lights of one color and remove them from the screen. Clear every light before the time limit to finish the level. Completing the board early earns a better score. Use the mouse or touchscreen to play.

pages.title: Drift Boss
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drift Boss sends a car along a route that requires well-timed changes of direction. Click or tap to drift toward the upper right as the car travels toward the upper left, anticipating the tight parts of the course. Daily rewards and lootboxes offer additional car skins as you play.

pages.title: Balloon Protect
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Balloon Protect challenges you to keep moving objects away from your character. Move the protector with the mouse to block the hazards before they can reach the character.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Stars
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Stars is a timed marble-clearing game with 48 levels. Shoot marbles into groups of at least three matching colors and remove every marble to complete the board. Different ball types and power-ups appear in the challenges, and finishing early improves your score. Use mouse or touch input to play.

pages.title: Kart Fight.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Kart Fight.io is an arena battle in which you knock opponents out to grow bigger and stronger. Keep pushing rivals off the arena until you are the last one remaining. Click and drag the mouse to control your kart.

pages.title: War Ship
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: War Ship is a naval combat game about firing missiles and avoiding enemy hits. Click to fire at the opposing ships while trying to keep your own vessel from being sunk.

pages.title: M Offroad Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: M Offroad Cars Puzzle offers six car pictures to rebuild as jigsaws. Choose an image and a layout with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, then use the mouse to assemble it. All four piece counts are available for each picture.

pages.title: BTS Baby Doll Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Baby Doll Coloring lets you choose a baby-doll picture and give it your own colors. Browse the book's images, select one you want to paint and work on it with the available palette. Use mouse or touch input to play.

pages.title: Great Chase
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Great Chase is an avoidance game in which enemies and other moving hazards threaten your character. Use the mouse to guide it clear of the obstacles and incoming projectiles. Collect cubes to earn points and work toward a higher score while keeping the chase going.

pages.title: Dashy Worm
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dashy Worm is an obstacle-course game in which you jump over hazards or dig beneath them. Use W and S or the Up and Down arrows for those actions. Collect coins to obtain a stronger character that can make later sections easier to get through.

pages.title: King Of Fishing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: King Of Fishing is an arcade fishing game played with a cannon. Aim and shoot nets at passing fish to catch them and earn gold. Use the mouse to play, directing your shots through the busy underwater scene.

pages.title: EG Space Transport
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Space Transport is a color-matching challenge involving spaceships and black holes. Keep their colors the same, choosing between red, yellow, blue and green as each ship arrives. A mismatch ends the attempt. Use mouse clicks, touch or the A, S, D and F keys to change colors while the game gradually speeds up.

pages.title: Helix Piano Tiles
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Helix Piano Tiles puts a bouncing musical note on a tower of piano loops. Move the tower to line up openings and let the note descend through them. Guide it past the obstacles and down toward the finish.

pages.title: Lamborghini drift simulator
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Lamborghini drift simulator lets you practice drifting a sports car, with the simulation modeling its movement and collisions. Control the car through slides and experience how it responds as you drive.

pages.title: Colour Zigzag
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Colour Zigzag sends a ball along a zigzag course as you work toward a high score. Click to change the ball's color during the run.

pages.title: Pong Arcade
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Pong Arcade is a ball-bouncing game controlled by tilting a paddle. Tap and release to adjust its angle and keep the ball in play. Successful bounces add to your score, while dropping the ball below the play area ends the attempt.

pages.title: Little Princess Puzzle Game 2
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Little Princess Puzzle Game 2 combines coloring and matching activities for Tiana and Ladybug. Help Tiana work on the pictures she wants to color, then help Ladybug with her puzzle-matching challenge. Use the mouse to interact with the objects in each activity.

pages.title: High School Romance
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: High School Romance is a dress-up game about a couple preparing for school. Choose clothing from the available fashion items and put together an outfit for each character as they try to impress one another.

pages.title: Billiards Game
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Billiards Game turns clearing the table into a race against the clock. Pocket all fifteen balls to finish, with the total time in seconds recorded as your result. Try to complete the clearance in less time on another attempt.

pages.title: Special Wars
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Special Wars is a 3D multiplayer shooter with four soldier classes and different weapons for each. Choose a class and fight opponents using an arsenal that includes machine guns, flamethrowers and revolvers. Take part in gunfights and work your way up the rankings.

pages.title: Tap My Water
pages.creator: Oleksandr Kovrygin
pages.description: Tap My Water is a plumbing puzzle about keeping a route open for flowing water. Select neighboring pipe pieces to swap their positions and connect the sections into a continuous path. Work against the time bar while helping the plumber repair the water supply.

pages.title: Trampoline Stickman
pages.creator: Plonga.com
pages.description: Trampoline Stickman is a bouncing game about performing frontflips and backflips on a trampoline. Keep the stickman in motion and work on the aerial tricks as you try to become the top performer.

pages.title: Twins Birthday Wishes
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Rachel prepare a birthday surprise for her two daughters in Twins Birthday Wishes. Dress the twins in cute dresses or superhero costumes, then choose accessories to finish their birthday looks.

pages.title: Crusader Defence
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Crusader Defence is a strategy game about protecting a castle from enemy waves. Use the mouse to choose a position and buy defenders, including pikemen, archers and knights. Each unit costs money, so build a defense you can afford and improve its weapons as you progress.

pages.title: Snake Escape
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Snake Escape offers Classic and Escape modes. In Classic, steer the snake toward food to grow and build a score. Escape mode turns the movement into a maze challenge, with an exit to reach and obstacles to navigate around. Use the arrow keys to change direction, or play with the mouse controls.

pages.title: Ace of the Pile
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Ace of the Pile is an Aces Up card game about leaving only the four aces on the board. Work with the exposed cards in four columns: you can discard a lower card when a higher one of the same suit is showing, with aces ranking highest. If it cannot be discarded, a top card can move into an empty column. Deal more cards when needed and try to remove everything except the aces.

pages.title: Prom Queen and King
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prom Queen and King follows a princess preparing for prom night, when the royal titles will be awarded. Help her select a dress and shoes, then choose a hairstyle to complete her look for the event.

pages.title: Princess Team Bohemian
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Team Bohemian lets you style Elsa, Jasmine and Aurora in bohemian outfits. Start with their hair, choosing looks such as waves for Elsa or braids for Aurora and Jasmine. Then put together clothes with geometric or floral prints, fringes or ruffles. Finish the outfits with long earrings, hair flowers, shoes and handbags.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Coronation
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Princess Mermaid Coronation is a dress-up game about preparing three friends for a coronation. Choose a tiara for the blonde princess and try different mermaid tails and tops, then dress her two friends for the event. Tap to make your selections and complete their celebration looks.
